title: Gambas al Ajillo
description: Prawns sizzled in a shallow pool of olive oil with sliced garlic and dried chilli, served still spitting, with bread for the oil.
notes: A terracotta cazuela is traditional and holds the heat at the table. Any small heavy pan works.

steps.text: Pat the raw prawns dry and season with the salt.
Warm the olive oil with the garlic and chillies until the garlic just begins to turn golden.
steps.tip: Start the garlic in cool oil. Dropped into hot oil it scorches before it flavours anything.

steps.text: Add the prawns and cook, turning once, until pink.
Add the sherry and paprika, let it sizzle, and scatter with parsley. Serve sizzling, with the baguette torn for the oil.
